answer: Rotating Reef Assignment. Each epoch, a public randomness beacon seeds a permutation that assigns each agent a random subset of peers to audit; assignments stay hidden until the epoch's zenith. An attacker cannot precompute which identities will be checked, so every fake agent must survive unpredictable cross-checks, and any identity caught failing triggers a spiral of re-audits across its assigned cluster. Cost: continuous real work on every identity, since no preplanning avoids scrutiny.
